title: 醫學遺傳學
intro: 遺傳諮詢、基因檢測判讀、罕見疾病與新生兒篩檢。 本科程序庫由課程工序生成，並標示為模板生成。
introEn: Genetic counselling, test interpretation, rare disease and newborn screening. This library is generated from the course steps and labelled as template-generated.

procedures.title: 遺傳模式與家族譜
procedures.patient: 依課程「遺傳模式與家族譜」設定的虛擬情境：體染色體顯／隱性、X 連鎖、粒線體與外顯率。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Inheritance patterns and pedigrees": Autosomal dominant/recessive, X-linked, mitochondrial and penetrance. The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.
